outputSchema.help: Final escalation decision. Must be exactly one of: RETURN, ENGINEERING, HUMAN_REVIEW.
outputSchema.name: decision
outputSchema.label: Decision

outputSchema.help: Confidence in the decision as a whole number from 0 to 100.
outputSchema.name: confidence
outputSchema.label: Confidence

outputSchema.help: Concise explanation of why this ticket received the selected decision, based only on the ticket information and available Sendex knowledge.
outputSchema.name: reasoning
outputSchema.label: Reasoning

outputSchema.help: Information or troubleshooting evidence Support still needs to collect or verify. Return "None" when no additional information is required.
outputSchema.name: missing_information
outputSchema.label: Missing Information

outputSchema.help: Concise next action for Support based on the decision. For RETURN, state what Support should do next. For ENGINEERING, state what should be escalated. For HUMAN_REVIEW, state what a human should review.
outputSchema.name: recommended_action
outputSchema.label: Recommended Action

outputSchema.help: Classify the demonstrated impact as SINGLE_CUSTOMER, MULTIPLE_CUSTOMERS, or UNKNOWN based only on evidence in the ticket and retrieved Sendex knowledge. Do not infer multiple customers without evidence.
outputSchema.name: impact_scope
outputSchema.label: Impact Scope

outputSchema.help: Number of customers demonstrably affected. Use 1 for a confirmed single-customer issue. Use 0 when the number cannot be determined. Do not estimate or invent a number.
outputSchema.name: customers_affected
outputSchema.label: Customers Affected

outputSchema.help: A concise description or identifier of a clearly relevant historical ticket, known issue, or incident pattern found in the provided Sendex knowledge. Return "None" if no clearly relevant match exists. Do not invent matches, ticket IDs, incident IDs, or issue names.
outputSchema.name: similar_ticket_match
outputSchema.label: Similar Ticket / Known Issue Match
